numeric_encoding_note: Exact integers outside the JavaScript safe-integer range (absolute value greater than 9007199254740991) are encoded as decimal strings to preserve every digit in browser display and JSON downloads. Fusion-tensor coefficients remain integers.

invariants.exact_dimension_method: Each FP dimension is the largest real root of its displayed irreducible polynomial, isolated by the rational interval. invariants.closed_based_subrings_method: Exhaustive subsets containing the unit, closed under duality and every nonzero fusion-product coefficient. Includes the unit subring and the whole ring.
